title: Improved Consistency of Lung Nodule Categorization in CT Scans with Heterogeneous Slice Thickness by Deep Learning-Based 3D Super-Resolution
summary: Deep-learning reconstruction improves radiologist-rated lung-nodule image quality across slice thicknesses. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.

evidence.tested: Deep-learning reconstruction improves radiologist-rated lung-nodule image quality across slice thicknesses.
evidence.unknown: No prospective clinical benefit or broader external validity is established by the documented study.
